reviewer.method: Round-3 (v8) independent pass verifying the single fix applied after v7's blocking finding. Read review/findings-preview-v7.json in full (both halves) as the baseline to carry forward. Verified provenance first: sha256sum of output/preview.mp4 is 08f193305ccc4ea6b55852655e9ff4f45ca88a72797086c7772af61525f184eb, matching output/preview-reference/evidence.json's output_sha256 exactly, and every shot-0/5/9/13 reference PNG's actual sha256 matches its evidence.json entry -- confirming the provided evidence set is this exact current render, not stale. Read project.json's shot-5 block directly (lines 1206-1295): the label 'Pencarian literatur akademik' is now at x=160,y=26,size=26 (was x=160,y=112 per v7), with the laptop at x=80,y=60,w=560 (840x600 source aspect, renders y60-460) and the search-box image at y=140 unchanged. Ran `git show 5b2d34f -- project.json` to inspect the actual committed diff for this fix: confirmed it touches only that single y=112->y=26 value and nothing else in the file, which independently corroborates (beyond prose claims) that scenes 1-4 shots 0-4/6-8/10-13 are byte-identical in source to what v7 reviewed, since rendering is deterministic over an unchanged project.json and unchanged input assets (project_inputs sha256 list in evidence.json also unchanged). For shot-5: extracted 8 fresh frames across its full 15.0-17.833s on-screen duration directly from output/preview.mp4 with ffmpeg (15.00/15.50/16.00/16.40/16.80/17.20/17.50/17.80s), cropped and lanczos-upscaled the x80-640,y0-200 top region at three of those times into one tile, and inspected a full uncropped frame at 16.40s. The label sits with clear white space above and below it, entirely between the top frame edge and the laptop lid's top bezel line, with no bezel stroke crossing any letter at any sampled time; it does not touch or overlap 'musik' or the three result-card thumbnails inside the screen below; it is not clipped by the frame's top edge (visible grid background above the text); and it is legible (grey #6b7280 script, same size as before) throughout. This clears the blocking fault freshly rather than assuming the fix worked. Re-verified shot-5's other six checks against v7's record rather than assuming no regression: extracted frames at 16.90s and 17.10s cropped to the two-character region and tiled them, confirming the pose swap (Ardipal talk->listen, Vidka listen->turn) still occurs correctly around 17.00s, matching v7's drawing_character/semantic_acting observations; ran ffmpeg ebur128 on the exact shot-5 segment (15.0s, duration 2.833s) and got Integrated loudness -20.5 LUFS, LRA 17.7 LU, consistent with v7's sound observation for this shot. contact_continuity and timing_pacing for shot-5 depend only on the laptop/characters/result-cards, none of which changed, and were re-confirmed visually in the same frames pulled for the label check. For the spot-check of unrelated shots: extracted one frame each from the current preview.mp4 at shot-0 (1.4s), shot-9 (36.9s) and shot-13 (57.5s) and visually compared the full frame against v7's per-shot prose -- all three match v7's descriptions exactly (shot-0: article stack, red 'bingung memilih', metronome+'tempo kelompok kami' label bottom-right, unmoved; shot-9: yellow 'KONSEP' note landed, pink note still parked top-right unlanded, 'Berguna untuk konsep ini' caption present; shot-13: red 'temuan (cakupan terbatas)' header, three-line claim, connector line, two-line red question with yellow underline, all present and positioned as v7 described) -- combined with the git diff scope check above, this gives two independent lines of evidence that shots other than shot-5 are genuinely unchanged, not just carried-forward assumptions. All 13 non-shot-5 shots' six checks each, the baseline comparisons, the full_playback entries for times other than 15.0s, and the 'limits' section are carried forward verbatim from findings-preview-v7.json without new inspection, since the project.json diff and frame spot-checks both independently rule out any change reaching them. Only shot-5's composition_evidence and typography_captions (and the blocking_issues entry and the 15.0s full_playback observation that referenced the old fault) were re-authored fresh in this pass.
